status: Working result with scoped independent local review. Formal review pending.

conventions.angular: Same stationary participating throughput across mirrors and registration controls. Per-link arrival rate j, exponential residence tau_feed=1 and tau_rim=128. Center attachment on capture. Swiveling sites acquire an independent constant angular registration hazard 1/256, register immediately, or never register. Mean stiffness j k ell² tau²/(tau+T) times prescribed visibility. The preferred phase and visibility are inherited from the earlier prepared seven-shell angular test. j k ell² tau_feed/K=2. The local held-cohort readings are synthetic predictions of this law. Neither the throughput nor these time scales were inferred from a physical mouth.
conventions.certificates: Two mesh levels, two rotations and both mirror orientations. In the archived bounds a transmitting trial has zero rim mismatch. Wrong-rim cost grows with the minimum rim stiffness. Feed mismatch energies are nonnegative. The preferred screened trial has zero attachment mismatch on every link. Reported threshold inequalities are sufficient. The mean-energy ground state does not establish dynamical selection, lifetime, outgoing Maxwell charge or radius independence.
conventions.energy: Registration at mismatch can raise interaction energy by k ell² v (1-cos(delta)); a reservoir or a thermodynamically specified rate law and release channel are needed at finite mismatch. The DC translational accounting includes outgoing kinetic energy and release of stored center spring energy on detachment.
conventions.mechanics: One representative flowing mass stream counted once. Exponential departure independent of age, speed and angle. m=k=ell=1, Omega²=k/m, unstretched birth at sideways speed U. Stationary resident inventory with zero initial sideways motion. The only actuator load is the translational spring reaction at the massless geometric center. Four smooth force-controlled ensemble drives in resting incoming material using F0*(1-exp(-t/t0))³, t0=min(tau,4), time measured in feed dwells. Gamma is the DC coefficient. It is not a measurement of whole-mouth inertia.
conventions.finite_counts: Stationary Poisson arrivals per link. Conditional fixed angular phase and visibility per registered contact. For different microscopic populations nu=j tau_feed, single-contact k ell²/K=2/nu preserves the mean strengths. Conservatively bound the complement of sufficient frozen-snapshot conditions on one level-3 mesh by the sum of all marginal tail probabilities; no cross-link independence required. Numerical SciPy evaluations are not outward-rounded interval bounds. No conclusion about long-time histories or force control for individual random patches.

review.primary_verdict: Scoped clear for the eight archived mean-energy ground-state comparisons and the ensemble force, momentum and DC energy balance of one exponentially renewing spring patch. Physical registration, realized flux histories and whole-mouth free fall remain open.
review.followup_verdict: Scoped clear for the smooth force-controlled response of the stationary mean patch and the Poisson union bound for a single frozen collar snapshot with the stated per-link energies.
review.method: Independent exact rational trial-versus-forbidden-state comparisons using the archived energy terms, vector spring arms, age integration at constant and harmonic drives, and DC work balance. Follow-up source audit of force inversion and finite-occupancy tail events.
